Name: Heleb, Son of Baanah
Summary: Heleb, son of Baanah the Netophathite, was among David's thirty mighty men. His father is distinct from Baanah son of Rimmon, Ish-bosheth's murderer.
KeyStory: Heleb son of Baanah the Netophathite stood among David's thirty.
RelatedPeople: King David; Baanah, Father of Heleb
LifeLesson: Two Baanahs, two sons, two opposite stories — the record tells them apart.
